profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Wavetrix
profile.summary:
ADVERTISERS/SALESPEOPLE, PLEASE NOTE:  I AM NOT IN AN I.T. POSITION.  PLEASE DO NOT CALL ME TO TRY AND SELL OUTSOURCED I.T. SERVICES (SAN/Storage, Databases, etc.).

Experience in all levels of software development, from microcontroller code to operating systems and device drivers, to application code.  Languages include C, C++, Fortran, Ada, PPC assembly, MIPS assembly.  Some Windows programming experience, most experience is in Unix / Linux and VxWorks.  Experienced in board bring-up & BSPs.

Also experienced in system engineering activities including requirements analysis and development, Failure Mode Effects Analysis (FMEA), test development, proposal development.

Specialties: Board bring-up / BSP
VxWorks, Linux, uClinux, QNX, various Unix variants
Device drivers
Systems analysis

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for systems analysis and design; requirements formulation; architecture of hardware/firmware solutions.
Design and lead platform architectures.

positions.title: Sr. Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for BSP, Device Driver, and embedded application development on custom hardware (MIPS and ARM processors).

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer / Systems Engineer
positions.description: This position is listed under different names in my profile: SRI, Software Remodeling, SRI Product Development.  This was a small consulting company, where I worked as an embedded software developer and systems engineer on a variety of projects ranging from defense, to telecom, to medical, to consumer electronics.  During my time with SRI, I was contracted out on-site to ADC, and later to Xalted Networks.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Requirements · Product Requirements · Strategic Thinking · Wiring Diagrams · Embedded Linux · Timelines · Engineering Drawings · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) · Customer Requirements · Technical Specs · Root Cause · Presentations · Technical Understanding · Schematic · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Requirements Management · Computer Science · Assembly Drawings · Embedded C · System Architecture

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: See SRI Product Development position.  Software Remodeling Inc. was the prior name of SRI Product Development.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Requirements · Embedded Linux · Timelines · Engineering Drawings · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) · Root Cause · Presentations · Technical Understanding · Schematic · Computer Science · Embedded C

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Contract engineer, did BSP development (VxWorks) on 6 8260-based boards.  Led board-level firmware development effort; participated in board design reviews; worked with Hardware engineers to find solutions to issues with new board designs.  Designed and wrote some of the C++ infrastructure used by the application team.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Requirements · Strategic Thinking · Timelines · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Engineering Drawings · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) · Technical Understanding · Schematic · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Computer Science · Embedded C

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: This was a contract position in which I ported the 2.2.x Linux kernel to a custom PowerPC-based board.  I also re-worked the SAR and Switch-Fabric drivers, and helped implement a signal-degradation-detection method for optical-ring-direction decision-making.  I also analyzed SCSI drive failures from the field, eventually determining that the issue was due to hardware, not firmware.  My data led the hardware engineer to discover that the issue resulted from a cost-reduction change which relaxed the tolerance on the SCSI termination resistors.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Requirements · Embedded Linux · Timelines · Engineering Drawings · Technical Understanding · Schematic · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Computer Science · Embedded C

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: At this position, I worked on a NASA-designed program for the FAA involving optimization of some air-traffic-control functions.  Largely, the work entailed adapting a fuzzy-logic based system to different environments.  I was also allowed the opportunity to implement an experimental feature into the NASA code shortly before I left.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Requirements · Timelines · Engineering Drawings · Technical Understanding · Computer Science · Embedded C

positions.title: Guidance and Control Engineer
positions.description:
This position is listed as TI/Texas Instruments/Raytheon TI Systems/Raytheon Systems in my profile because of the variety of names the company went under while I was there.

In this position, I was responsible for developing and implementing guide laws and controls (e.g., autopilot) for a large defense project.

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description: In this position, I was the systems and network administrator for the Aerospace Engineering department (and later the Offshore Technology Center) at Texas A&M.  In that role, I maintained a moderately-large network of everything from PCs; Sun, SGI, IBM, NeXT workstations; to the occasional Mac.  I was instrumental in establishing the first networked lab for the undergraduate Aerospace program.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description: See United Space Alliance.  This company was restructured during my time there.
positions.insights: Skills: Strategic Thinking · Engineering Drawings · Presentations · Technical Understanding · Computer Science

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description: I worked for United Space Alliance as a student liason between the company and Texas A&M University (basically, it was an internship on-site at NASA/Johnson Space Center).  For my time there, I was part of the DF45 (robotics) group at NASA/JSC, working on a project that was applying research into path-planning (graph theory) to the robotic manipulator system for the International Space Station.  My role was to improve on work previously done by a Ph.D. candidate to try to achieve near-real-time path-planning for the robot arm, through an obstacle field described by a proprietary NASA graphics library language.
positions.insights: Skills: Strategic Thinking · Engineering Drawings · Presentations · Technical Understanding · Computer Science

patents.title: Method and Apparatus of Processing Symbology Interactions between Mobile stations and a Control System
patents.description: A method for creating, displaying, and utilizing quick response (QR) codes to perform processing in an application on a mobile device and a control system network.

patents.title: Gesture based control application for data sharing
patents.description: A method of using gestures to control data sharing in environments such as classrooms and corporate meeting rooms.
